description: The Engineering Paradox: Forensic dashboard of production vs. infrastructure loss.
methodology: Forensic Synchronicity: Implemented an H-Sync dashboard architecture. Module A (Net Gain): A central radial gauge that mathematically derives the 'Net Survival Gain' by subtracting infrastructure leakage from engineered production. Module B (The Paradox): A high-fidelity text-based HUD contrasting 'Engineered Production' (Desal) against 'Unseen Infrastructure Loss' (Non-Revenue Water). Mathematical Derivation: Production and Loss volumes were harmonized from the Victorian Water Accounts to reveal years of negative engineered net-gain (e.g., 2018). Aesthetic: Industrial control-room theme with chromatic shift logic.
citation: Melbourne Water. (2026). Greater Melbourne Potable Demand & Infrastructure Loss Data. Spatially and temporally harmonized by D. Sharma (2026).
